scope: Washington 39-county authoritative parcel inventory reconstruction from repository evidence.

doctrine.parcelRuntimeSource: Canonical parcels must be backed by official assessor/GIS/open-data parcel inventory sources, not sales/comparable artifacts.
doctrine.productionCertification: Rows without receipt-grade parcel inventory evidence remain real but not production-certifiable.
doctrine.databaseMutation: This gate is read-only and performs no database mutation.
